create_custom_allreduce: create a CustomAllreduce instance with a process group and device for distributed GPU all-reduce operations
test_custom_all_reduce: test whether a tensor qualifies for custom all-reduce based on size, contiguity, and world size constraints
run_custom_all_reduce: run custom all-reduce on a tensor with optional registered buffer and output tensor arguments
review_capture_context: review the CUDA graph capture context manager that registers graph buffers at exit
build_shared_buffer: build a shared memory buffer across ranks using allocate_shared_buffer_and_handle and all_gather_object
